name: Exec Cluster E09: Stepped Trailing Stop
description: Tests: trailing_stop with step option for discrete ratcheting
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E09: Stepped Trailing Stop
# Tests: trailing_stop(step=1.0) — discrete ratcheting vs continuous
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === VOLATILITY ===
atr_val = atr(src.h, src.l, src.c, 14)

# === SIGNAL: Donchian breakout ===
donchian = donchian_channel(src.h, src.l, window=20)
upper_prior = donchian.donchian_upper >> 1
lower_prior = donchian.donchian_lower >> 1

entry_long = close > upper_prior
entry_short = close < lower_prior
held_long = hold_until(entry_long, entry_short)
held_short = hold_until(entry_short, entry_long)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# Fixed percent sizing
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=20)

# Fixed stop as floor (required for trailing to activate)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=atr_val * 3)

# E09: Stepped trailing stop — ratchets in $1.00 increments, tightens above SL
trailing_stop(step=1.0)(distance=atr_val * 2)
